evals.prompt: I want to start tracking my work on a new feature. Start a session called 'payment-flow'. The goal is: add Stripe payment integration to our e-commerce app. The initial plan is: 1) Set up Stripe account and get API keys, 2) Install Stripe SDK, 3) Build payment form UI, 4) Handle Stripe webhooks, 5) Write tests and test end-to-end. After starting the session, confirm what was created.
evals.expected_output: Session file created at ~/.claude/sessions/payment-flow.md with goal, plan as checklist items. Index.md updated. .active file written.

assertions.description: Goal section contains the Stripe integration goal
Plan is formatted as Markdown checkboxes (unchecked)
index.md was created or updated with payment-flow row

evals.prompt: First, create two sessions: one called 'api-refactor' with goal 'Migrate REST API to GraphQL', and one called 'auth-overhaul' with goal 'Replace JWT auth with OAuth2'. Now pretend you just opened Claude fresh and want to continue working — say 'resume session' without giving a name, and show what the session picker output looks like.
evals.expected_output: Both sessions created. When 'resume session' is called with no name, Claude shows a numbered list of recent sessions to pick from (not just picks one automatically).

assertions.description: Agent presents a numbered list for the user to pick from, not auto-resuming
The list output contains both session names

evals.prompt: Start a session called 'db-migration' with goal 'Migrate PostgreSQL database to cloud'. Plan: 1) Audit current schema, 2) Set up RDS instance, 3) Write migration scripts, 4) Test migration on staging, 5) Run production migration. Now: step 1 (Audit current schema) is done, step 2 (Set up RDS instance) is also done, and we discovered we need to also update connection strings in the app config. Do a checkpoint to save all this progress.
evals.expected_output: Session file updated: steps 1 and 2 marked [x] and moved to Completed Tasks, 'update connection strings' added to Pending Tasks, daily log entry written, index.md updated with today's date.

assertions.description: Steps 1 and 2 marked as [x] in plan or moved to Completed Tasks
Connection strings task appears in Pending Tasks
Daily Log has an entry for today
index.md shows updated last_active date for db-migration
